<!-- pr-reviewer: dffc7fe67c7b2d8af7a410431d621dc0de0279be -->
**Review of head dffc7fe67: clean. Ready to merge.** An independent read-only review and my read of the code and the skill text. The agent that wrote the change did not write this review.

- The rule (`xtask/src/example_suites.rs`): a diff that changes a file under `assets/posts/`, `assets/machines/`, `examples/`, `crates/post/src/` or `crates/motion/src/` adds nine app suites to the quick plan: the three `example_catalog*` suites, `first_part_programs`, `first_router_part`, `first_4axis_part`, `continuous_4axis_part`, `tilt_basis_compat` and `catalog_groove_part_off`. The old catalog rule runs first and keeps its reason. No step is selected two times.
- The gate gives the paths with forward slashes. A deleted file triggers the rule also.
- The seven new tests call the real plan function on the real tree, for a post script, a machine file, a shipped program, a catalog case, the post engine and a docs-only change, and one test fails when a listed name is not a real test binary.
- A change in `post` or `motion` selected the app test build before this PR. The cost is nine more test steps.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!`. `quick.rs` stays at 400 lines. The skill text has one new true item. The body has `Process change: yes`, `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #3521`.

Run here on the trial merge with `main` 4c0a157e1 (the merge is clean): the xtask tests `example_suites` 7, `asset_tests` 5, `gate_maps_tests` 19, `directory` 21, `heavy_plan_tests` 11, `light_tests` 6, the catalog mapping test 1 and `step_tests` 5: all passed. Clippy on `xtask` with all targets is clean.

Notes, recorded on #3557 as follow-ups: a listed suite that does not exist is skipped with no note; the prefix `examples/` is wide; the match is case-sensitive; no test for a motion change.

Merge class: no refresh. It is a process PR: it merges when it is reviewed. The `PROCESS_VERSION` bump follows.
